research_question: How does the frozen direct TD-MPC2 method degrade under individually controlled learner-visible sensing, latency, and registered-frame errors?

numeric_basis.episode_force_bias_n: 0.8 N is the handbook relative-force-accuracy scale; 0.4 N is its midpoint.
numeric_basis.observation_delay_samples: Study-defined 10, 20, and 50 ms stresses at the frozen 100-Hz control rate.
numeric_basis.tcp_pose_error_magnitude_m: Half and full scale of the handbook's <+/-0.1 mm pose-repeatability figure; used only as a stress scale.
numeric_basis.surface_normal_error_magnitude_deg: Study-defined registered-frame calibration errors, not a measured camera distribution.

injection_contract.force_noise_and_bias: learner-visible force, force rate, and contact indicator only; outcome metrics retain native force
injection_contract.observation_delay: entire 16-D learner observation; outcome metrics remain current
injection_contract.tcp_pose_error: fixed episode-level cross/normal observation offset with deterministic direction
injection_contract.surface_normal_error: same biased registered frame used by geometric observation channels and task-frame action mapping
injection_contract.trace_fields: native value, perturbed current value, delayed learner-visible value, policy action, and issued actuator action

analysis.primary_use: descriptive paired degradation curves; no superiority gate
analysis.uncertainty: paired point estimates and 95% intervals over the fixed checkpoint roster; conclusions restricted to the specified blocks and levels
analysis.failure_handling: all finite scientific failures retained; no post-result level changes

claim_boundary: Simulation stress evidence only; not a hardware success rate or a joint real-system error model.
